inspiration.observed_pattern: Two JSON_TABLE list expansions feed independently grouped label lists that a CASE/CONCAT projection combines into one report value.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one bundle with one included and one excluded component while retaining two JSON_TABLE expansions, ordered GROUP_CONCAT, conditional separator logic, and final projection.

fixture_notes: Bundle 801 includes Copper and excludes Latex, producing `Include Copper - Exclude Latex`.
determinism_notes: The bundle ID, component codes, labels, ordered aggregation, conditional separator, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_component_catalog (component_code VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY, component_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mini_component_bundles (bundle_id INT PRIMARY KEY, bundle_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, include_codes VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, exclude_codes VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH included AS (SELECT b.bundle_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.component_label ORDER BY c.component_label SEPARATOR ', ') AS included_labels FROM mini_component_bundles AS b INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[\"', REPLACE(b.include_codes, ',', '\",\"'), '\"]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (component_code VARCHAR(16) PATH '$')) AS j ON TRUE INNER JOIN mini_component_catalog AS c ON c.component_code = j.component_code GROUP BY b.bundle_id), excluded AS (SELECT b.bundle_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.component_label ORDER BY c.component_label SEPARATOR ', ') AS excluded_labels FROM mini_component_bundles AS b INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[\"', REPLACE(b.exclude_codes, ',', '\",\"'), '\"]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (component_code VARCHAR(16) PATH '$')) AS j ON TRUE INNER JOIN mini_component_catalog AS c ON c.component_code = j.component_code GROUP BY b.bundle_id) SELECT b.bundle_id, CONCAT(CASE WHEN i.included_labels IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('Include ', i.included_labels) END, CASE WHEN i.included_labels IS NOT NULL AND e.excluded_labels IS NOT NULL THEN ' - ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN e.excluded_labels IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('Exclude ', e.excluded_labels) END) AS component_summary FROM mini_component_bundles AS b LEFT JOIN included AS i ON i.bundle_id = b.bundle_id LEFT JOIN excluded AS e ON e.bundle_id = b.bundle_id ORDER BY b.bundle_id

checks.sql: SELECT bundle_id, bundle_name, include_codes, exclude_codes FROM mini_component_bundles ORDER BY bundle_id
